claims.statement: Tom Allen covered the $500 that Joe Goss deposited with Eph Holland of Cincinnati to make a match for the championship of America and a purse of $1,000 to $5,900 (printed as $5,900).
claims.excerpt: has been covered by Allen, anda fight will come off in about a month's time.

notes: Reprinted from the London Sporting and Dramatic News (citing Sporting Life). The Globe-Democrat says it doubts the fight will happen at all.
